packs.name: solar-system
packs.description: Solar System v1: Sun, planets, Moon, Pluto and the system barycenters. Mars to Pluto are placed at their system barycenters, flagged approximate (ADR-0008). Ephemeris DE440 (de440s.bsp), radii and IAU rotation elements from pck00011.tpc, GM from gm_de440.tpc, leap seconds and the TDB - TT model from naif0012.tls. Stars: the Bright Star Catalogue, 5th revised edition (CDS V/50). Saturn's rings: radii from the IAU WGPSN Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature, optical depths from the PDS Ring-Moon Systems Node (Tier 2). The Moon's orientation: the DE440 lunar principal axes (moon_pa_de440_200625.bpc) rotated to the mean Earth/polar axis frame MOON_ME_DE440_ME421 (moon_de440_250416.tf).

packs.name: solar-system-moons
packs.description: Solar System with the major moons, 2000 to 2100 (optional, built locally: P6-01, NFR-07). The v1 bodies with the planet centers from the JPL satellite ephemerides, and 21 major moons. Planets, Sun and Moon from DE440 (de440s.bsp); each satellite system (moons and planet center relative to the system barycenter) from its satellite kernel (mar099, jup365, sat441, ura184_part-3, nep097, plu060); records copied bit for bit. Radii and IAU rotation elements from pck00011.tpc, GM from gm_de440.tpc, leap seconds and the TDB - TT model from naif0012.tls. Stars: the Bright Star Catalogue, 5th revised edition (CDS V/50). Saturn's rings: radii from the IAU WGPSN Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature, optical depths from the PDS Ring-Moon Systems Node (Tier 2). The Moon's orientation: the DE440 lunar principal axes (moon_pa_de440_200625.bpc) rotated to the mean Earth/polar axis frame MOON_ME_DE440_ME421 (moon_de440_250416.tf). The Earth's orientation: ITRF93 from the combined historical and long-term predict Earth PCK earth_1962_260806_2126_combined.bpc (low accuracy after its last datum, 2026-08-06).
